name: zanker-motion-design
description: Design purposeful CSS/Motion/GSAP animation with reduced-motion equivalents.

workflow.instruction: Explain state change or spatial relationship communicated by motion.
Run motion-search.sh for the task; declare direction contract (purpose, law, motif, entry) and apply design meter anti-patterns from the JSON response.
Default to css or component surfaces from the catalog; video only on explicit reel/film/logo-loop requests with upstream Remotion license note; no default install.
Read knowledge/media/motion-design.json; optional motion-css.sh for tokens.
Test prefers-reduced-motion, focus, exit timing, design meter UI checks and performance.

acceptance: No generic design-meter tropes without intent
fallback: Offer a static transition or simpler state feedback.
